review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked whether its declarations compete with existing Mathlib concepts. The candidates were contDiff_tsum_of_locallyFinite, memKernel, exists_finset_far, and the support and smoothness lemmas. Mathlib has contDiff_tsum and contDiff_tsum_of_eventually in SmoothSeries.lean. Those assume summable norm bounds or eventual vanishing of the terms, so they do not state the locally-finite-support hypothesis used here. Mathlib's contDiffAt_finsum is for smooth partitions of unity only. Even if it were a near-duplicate, that would be standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. memKernel is a specific indicator-times-exponential-polynomial function, not a competing definition of a Mathlib concept. memory_integral_eq_convolution deliberately links it to Mathlib's convolution. The remaining declarations are specific to the Ingredients structure. The definitions and lemmas here are used in Section4/CoarseCoeff/Regularity.lean and Section5/Integration/BigBoundRegularity.lean. I found no competing concept to consolidate, so I abstain.
